script_text: Aries, a Full Moon in Gemini is about to crack your Ninth House open. Monday through Wednesday, Sun in Sagittarius trines Saturn in your First House, giving authority traction, while the Full Moon conjuncts Uranus in your Third House, delivering sudden messages. Venus in Scorpio in your Eighth House intensifies love and shared-money talks; avoid jealous power plays. Midweek, Mars in Leo in your Fifth House trines Saturn, turning romantic boldness into commitment. Thursday through Sunday, Mercury in Sagittarius sextiles Pluto in your Eleventh House, connecting you with influential allies; a career offer can advance if you speak first. Weekend favors playful dates, but watch impulsive spending. Wednesday is your power day because the Full Moon activates your Third House with insight. Friday is your weakest day because Venus squares Pluto, exposing control issues. Use your Mars-ruled Fire to act boldly. Follow for daily updates.
